WC04 Camera 0.2.0 - EXPERIMENTAL

0.1.3 successfully captured 320x240 and 640x480 photos on the tester's Wii,
and both opened in the Photo Channel. This build adds a live viewfinder,
a new color renderer, and immediate photo review. Compiled and host-tested;
the new TV display and sustained live view still need hardware testing.

Copy apps/wc04-camera to the SD root's apps directory. Requires a WC04
(057e:030a), Wii Remote, and Homebrew Channel on IOS58. Insert writable FAT
SD before launch to save photos. Without SD, the viewfinder still works.
The app does not install or reload IOS and does not write to NAND.

Menu: A opens the viewfinder, 1 changes resolution, 2 scans the camera.
Live view: A takes a photo, B returns to the menu.
Photo review: A returns to live view, B returns to the menu.
HOME exits from any screen.

Photos: sd:/DCIM/100WC04/WC04####.JPG (existing files are not overwritten)
Log: sd:/wc04-camera/session.log (appended)

Please test live view for 30 seconds at each resolution before taking a photo.
Compare colors on the TV and in the Photo Channel. Try B then reopening the
viewfinder, and HOME while live. Return session.log and mention whether the
preview moved smoothly. This build does not explicitly change exposure;
leaving the camera running gives its automatic settings time to settle.

Preview targets up to about 15 updates per second; actual speed is unverified.
Saving uses the full selected resolution. Logs are written after stopping,
with Wii-clock timestamps, elapsed time, frame counts, and decode timing.
A ten-second period without a decoded frame stops the viewfinder.

If stopping waits for USB completion, unplug the camera. A wedged IOS control
request may require restarting the console. This is an experimental build.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
See licenses/ for the application and third-party notices.
